biography_english:
A Loslorien commander from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire. She was of House Glacius, patrons of the Galius Guild of Magi, and twin sister to the Dark Knight Oz. She wielded both spell and blade with equal skill.
  She died battling {hero} with her brother Oz at Phidoch Castle.
biography_spanish:
Comandante de Loslorien de Galius, sede del Imperio de Lodis. Era de la Casa Glacius, mecenas del gremio de magos, y hermana gemela del caballero oscuro Oz. Manejaba espada y magia por igual.                               
  Murio con su hermano Oz contra {hero} en el castillo Phidoch.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire. She is of House Glacius, patrons of the Galius Guild of Magi, and twin sister to the Dark Knight Oz. She wields both spell and blade with equal skill.
  She is betrothed to the Dark Knight Balxephon, and will marry him upon their return to Lodis once their task in Valeria is complete.

biography_english:
A Loslorien commander from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire. She is of House Glacius, patrons of the Galius Guild of Magi, and twin sister to the Dark Knight Oz. She wields both spell and blade with equal skill.
  She fled from a skirmish with {hero} at the Arkhaiopolis of Rhime. It seemed she recognized the blind swordsman who took part in the battle.

  Huyo de una escaramuza contra {hero} en la Arkhaiopolis de Rim. Parecio reconocer al espadachin ciego que participo en la batalla.

biography_english:
A former Loslorien commander from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire. She is of House Glacius, patrons of the Galius Guild of Magi, and twin sister to the Dark Knight Oz. She wields both spell and blade with equal skill.
  She was reunited with Hobyrim, to whom she was once betrothed, and learned the truth behind the rebellion in Lodis. This led her to renounce her allegiance to Lanselot Tartaros and side with the Resistance.

biography_english:
A young warrior hailing from the southern continent of Balboede who has trained in the use of the fusils made there.
  He came close to defeat at the hands of the Dark Knight Martym at Grimsby, but was saved by {hero}.
  He journeyed to Valeria to purvey the sophisticated weaponry of his homeland. The guns made there can inflict terrible damage, but require training to use as they are vastly different to more traditional weapons. Too elaborate to make in large quantities, they are sold for princely sums.
biography_spanish:
Un joven guerrero del continente sureno de Balboede entrenado en el uso de los fusiles hechos alli.                 
  Casi fue derrotado por el caballero Martym en Grimsby, pero fue salvado por {hero}.                
  Viajo a Valeria para vender las sofisticadas armas de su patria. Las armas de fuego de alli causan estragos terribles, pero exigen entrenamiento por ser muy distintas a las tradicionales. Muy complejas de hacer en masa, se venden por sumas altisimas.

biography_english: A Walister who captains the Knights of Almorica. He serves as the right hand of Duke Ronwey, and is a vital member of the Resistance. After the castle was recaptured, he set off for Krysaro in the southwest of Almorica to track down the Necromancer Nybeth. Reports indicate he is currently battling Nybeth's minions.
biography_spanish: Un walister que capitanea a los caballeros de Almorica. Es la mano derecha del duque Ronwey y un miembro vital de la Resistencia. Tras recapturar el castillo, partio hacia Krysaro en el suroeste de Almorica para rastrear al nigromante Nybeth. Los informes indican que actualmente lucha contra los esbirros de Nybeth.

biography_english:
A Walister who captains the Knights of Almorica. He serves as the right hand of Duke Ronwey, and is a vital member of the Resistance. His mother was killed by the Galgastani.
  He is a stoic and rational man not easily swayed by emotion.
biography_spanish:
Un walister que capitanea a los caballeros de Almorica. Mano derecha del duque Ronwey y vital miembro de la Resistencia. Su madre fue asesinada por los galgastani.           
  Es un hombre estoico y racional no movido por emocion.

biography_english:
A Walister who once captained the Knights of Almorica. He served as the right hand of Duke Ronwey, and was a vital member of the Resistance. His mother was killed by the Galgastani.
  He set in motion plans to usurp the Resistance leadership during the Bakram attack on Rhime. Though he succeeded in killing the duke, he was slain by {hero}.
biography_spanish:
Un walister que fue capitan de los caballeros de Almorica. Fue la mano derecha del duque Ronwey y vital miembro de la Resistencia. Su madre fue asesinada por los galgastani.        
  Puso en marcha planes para usurpar el liderazgo de la Resistencia durante el ataque bakram a Rhime. Aunque logro matar al duque, fue asesinado por {hero}.

biography_english:
A Walister who once captained the Knights of Almorica. He was a pillar of the Walister Resistance. His mother was killed by the Galgastani. After Duke Ronwey's death he became leader of the Resistance.
  He died battling the Dark Knights during the assault on Phidoch Castle.
biography_spanish:
Un walister que fue capitan de los caballeros de Almorica. Fue pilar de la Resistencia. Su madre fue asesinada por los galgastani. Tras la muerte del duque Ronwey se hizo jefe de la Resistencia.       
  Murio batallando contra los caballeros oscuros en el castillo Phidoch.
